tr.td: RQ1

tr.td: Where should the PDP live?

td.style: border: 1px solid rgb(187, 187, 187); padding: 3px 5px; vertical-align: top; background: rgb(255, 255, 255);

tr.td: placement, WAN delay, partition, cache TTL

td.style: border: 1px solid rgb(187, 187, 187); padding: 3px 5px; vertical-align: top; background: rgb(255, 255, 255);

tr.td: decision latency, availability under partition, revocation staleness, unauthorized window

td.style: border: 1px solid rgb(187, 187, 187); padding: 3px 5px; vertical-align: top; background: rgb(255, 255, 255);

tr.td: hierarchical ≈ fog latency with bounded staleness; only a fog replica stays available in a partition

td.style: border: 1px solid rgb(187, 187, 187); padding: 3px 5px; vertical-align: top; background: rgb(255, 255, 255);

tr.td: RQ2

td.style: border: 1px solid rgb(187, 187, 187); padding: 3px 5px; vertical-align: top; background: rgb(255, 255, 255);

tr.td: Which credential model?

td.style: border: 1px solid rgb(187, 187, 187); padding: 3px 5px; vertical-align: top; background: rgb(255, 255, 255);

tr.td: token / certificate / capability, TTL, device class, session teardown

td.style: border: 1px solid rgb(187, 187, 187); padding: 3px 5px; vertical-align: top; background: rgb(255, 255, 255);

tr.td: CPU per request (device, PEP), bytes on the wire, revocation latency, delegation support

td.style: border: 1px solid rgb(187, 187, 187); padding: 3px 5px; vertical-align: top; background: rgb(255, 255, 255);

tr.td: capabilities cheapest to verify and delegable; long mTLS sessions cheapest in steady state but worst at revocation unless torn down

td.style: border: 1px solid rgb(187, 187, 187); padding: 3px 5px; vertical-align: top; background: rgb(255, 255, 255);

tr.td: RQ3

td.style: border: 1px solid rgb(187, 187, 187); padding: 3px 5px; vertical-align: top; background: rgb(255, 255, 255);

tr.td: How does trust follow a migrating service?

td.style: border: 1px solid rgb(187, 187, 187); padding: 3px 5px; vertical-align: top; background: rgb(255, 255, 255);

tr.td: strategy, state size, bandwidth, PDP RTT, partition

td.style: border: 1px solid rgb(187, 187, 187); padding: 3px 5px; vertical-align: top; background: rgb(255, 255, 255);

tr.td: downtime, total migration time, exposure window, failure rate under partition

td.style: border: 1px solid rgb(187, 187, 187); padding: 3px 5px; vertical-align: top; background: rgb(255, 255, 255);

tr.td: fog-validated handover approaches pre-auth downtime with a much shorter exposure and survives partitions

td.style: border: 1px solid rgb(187, 187, 187); padding: 3px 5px; vertical-align: top; background: rgb(255, 255, 255);

tr.td: RQ4

td.style: border: 1px solid rgb(187, 187, 187); padding: 3px 5px; vertical-align: top; background: rgb(255, 255, 255);

tr.td: Is a compromised device locked out fast enough?

td.style: border: 1px solid rgb(187, 187, 187); padding: 3px 5px; vertical-align: top; background: rgb(255, 255, 255);

tr.td: detection probability / delay, trust half-life, compromise threshold, placement

td.style: border: 1px solid rgb(187, 187, 187); padding: 3px 5px; vertical-align: top; background: rgb(255, 255, 255);

tr.td: unauthorized access window, malicious requests allowed, false denials of honest devices

td.style: border: 1px solid rgb(187, 187, 187); padding: 3px 5px; vertical-align: top; background: rgb(255, 255, 255);

tr.td: window dominated by detection delay; placement matters only through cache staleness, bounded by epochs and invalidate-on-deny
